mapper.sql: t.hold_status = 'CONFIRMED' OR ( t.hold_status = 'HOLDING' AND (t.expired_at IS NULL OR t.expired_at > SYSTIMESTAMP) )
mapper.select: SELECT f.flight_id, f.flight_no, TRIM(dep.iata_code) AS departure_iata_code, TRIM(arr.iata_code) AS arrival_iata_code, f.departure_time, f.arrival_time, sc.seat_class_id, sc.class_name AS seat_class_name, ff.price FROM FLIGHT f JOIN ROUTE r ON r.route_id = f.route_id JOIN AIRPORT dep ON dep.airport_id = r.departure_airport_id JOIN AIRPORT arr ON arr.airport_id = r.arrival_airport_id JOIN FLIGHT_FARE ff ON ff.flight_id = f.flight_id AND ff.seat_class_id = #{seatClassId} JOIN SEAT_CLASS sc ON sc.seat_class_id = ff.seat_class_id WHERE f.flight_id = #{flightId} AND f.is_deleted = 'N' AND f.flight_status IN ('SCHEDULED', 'DELAYED') AND f.departure_time > SYSTIMESTAMP

SELECT s.seat_id, s.seat_no, s.seat_class_id, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TICKET t WHERE t.seat_id = s.seat_id AND t.flight_id = #{flightId} AND () ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS occupied_yn FROM SEAT s JOIN FLIGHT f ON f.aircraft_id = s.aircraft_id WHERE f.flight_id = #{flightId} AND s.seat_class_id = #{seatClassId} AND s.is_active = 'Y' ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(s.seat_no, '[0-9]+')), REGEXP_SUBSTR(s.seat_no, '[A-Z]+')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOOKING ( booking_no, member_id, trip_type, outbound_flight_id, inbound_flight_id, status, total_amount ) VALUES ( #{bookingNo}, #{memberId}, #{tripType}, #{outboundFlightId}, #{inboundFlightId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 'PENDING', 0 )

INSERT INTO BOOKING_PASSENGER ( booking_id, saved_passenger_id, name, birth_date, phone, gender, passport_no, passport_expiry, passenger_type ) VALUES ( #{bookingId}, #{savedPassengerId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{name}, #{birthDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{phone,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{gender,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{passportNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{passportExpiry,jdbcType=DATE}, #{passengerType} )

INSERT INTO TICKET ( booking_id, booking_passenger_id, flight_id, seat_id, leg_type, fare_amount, hold_status, held_at, expired_at ) VALUES ( #{bookingId}, #{bookingPassengerId}, #{flightId}, #{seatId}, #{legType}, #{fareAmount}, 'HOLDING', SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP + NUMTODSINTERVAL(#{holdMinutes}, 'MINUTE') )
mapper.select: SELECT payment_id, booking_id, method, amount, status, imp_uid, merchant_uid, paid_at, refund_amount, refunded_at, created_at FROM PAYMENT WHERE booking_id = #{bookingId} ORDER BY payment_id DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: UPDATE PAYMENT SET status = 'PAID', imp_uid = #{impUid}, method = #{method}, paid_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE booking_id = #{bookingId} AND status = 'READY'
UPDATE PAYMENT SET status = 'FAILED' WHERE booking_id = #{bookingId} AND status = 'READY'
UPDATE TICKET SET hold_status = 'CONFIRMED', expired_at = NULL WHERE booking_id = #{bookingId} AND hold_status = 'HOLDING' AND (expired_at IS NULL OR expired_at > SYSTIMESTAMP)
UPDATE BOOKING SET status = #{status}, cancelled_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'CANCELLED' THEN SYSTIMESTAMP ELSE cancelled_at END WHERE booking_id = #{bookingId}
UPDATE TICKET SET hold_status = 'RELEASED' WHERE booking_id = #{bookingId} AND hold_status = 'HOLDING'
UPDATE TICKET SET hold_status = 'RELEASED' WHERE hold_status = 'HOLDING' AND expired_at IS NOT NULL AND expired_at <= SYSTIMESTAMP
UPDATE BOOKING b SET b.status = 'FAILED' WHERE b.status = 'PENDING' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TICKET t WHERE t.booking_id = b.booking_id AND t.hold_status IN ('HOLDING', 'CONFIRMED') )
mapper.select:
SELECT b.booking_id, b.booking_no, b.member_id, b.trip_type, b.outbound_flight_id, b.inbound_flight_id, b.status, b.total_amount, b.created_at, b.cancelled_at,
of.flight_no AS outbound_flight_no, TRIM(odep.iata_code) AS outbound_departure_iata, TRIM(oarr.iata_code) AS outbound_arrival_iata, of.departure_time AS outbound_departure_time,
inf.flight_no AS inbound_flight_no, TRIM(idep.iata_code) AS inbound_departure_iata, TRIM(iarr.iata_code) AS inbound_arrival_iata, inf.departure_time AS inbound_departure_time,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOOKING_PASSENGER bp WHERE bp.booking_id = b.booking_id) AS passenger_count,
NVL((SELECT SUM(t.fare_amount) FROM TICKET t WHERE t.booking_id = b.booking_id AND t.hold_status IN ('HOLDING', 'CONFIRMED')), 0) AS valid_amount
FROM BOOKING b JOIN FLIGHT of ON of.flight_id = b.outbound_flight_id JOIN ROUTE oroute ON oroute.route_id = of.route_id JOIN AIRPORT odep ON odep.airport_id = oroute.departure_airport_id JOIN AIRPORT oarr ON oarr.airport_id = oroute.arrival_airport_id
LEFT JOIN FLIGHT inf ON inf.flight_id = b.inbound_flight_id LEFT JOIN ROUTE iroute ON iroute.route_id = inf.route_id LEFT JOIN AIRPORT idep ON idep.airport_id = iroute.departure_airport_id LEFT JOIN AIRPORT iarr ON iarr.airport_id = iroute.arrival_airport_id
WHERE b.member_id = #{memberId} AND b.status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'CANCELLED') ORDER BY b.created_at DESC

SELECT b.booking_id, b.booking_no, b.member_id, b.trip_type, b.outbound_flight_id, b.inbound_flight_id, b.status, b.total_amount, b.created_at, b.cancelled_at,
of.flight_no AS outbound_flight_no, TRIM(odep.iata_code) AS outbound_departure_iata, TRIM(oarr.iata_code) AS outbound_arrival_iata, of.departure_time AS outbound_departure_time,
inf.flight_no AS inbound_flight_no, TRIM(idep.iata_code) AS inbound_departure_iata, TRIM(iarr.iata_code) AS inbound_arrival_iata, inf.departure_time AS inbound_departure_time,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOOKING_PASSENGER bp WHERE bp.booking_id = b.booking_id) AS passenger_count,
NVL((SELECT SUM(t.fare_amount) FROM TICKET t WHERE t.booking_id = b.booking_id AND t.hold_status IN ('HOLDING', 'CONFIRMED')), 0) AS valid_amount
FROM BOOKING b JOIN FLIGHT of ON of.flight_id = b.outbound_flight_id JOIN ROUTE oroute ON oroute.route_id = of.route_id JOIN AIRPORT odep ON odep.airport_id = oroute.departure_airport_id JOIN AIRPORT oarr ON oarr.airport_id = oroute.arrival_airport_id
LEFT JOIN FLIGHT inf ON inf.flight_id = b.inbound_flight_id LEFT JOIN ROUTE iroute ON iroute.route_id = inf.route_id LEFT JOIN AIRPORT idep ON idep.airport_id = iroute.departure_airport_id LEFT JOIN AIRPORT iarr ON iarr.airport_id = iroute.arrival_airport_id
WHERE b.booking_id = #{bookingId} AND b.member_id = #{memberId}

SELECT t.ticket_id, t.booking_id, t.booking_passenger_id, t.flight_id, t.seat_id, t.leg_type, t.fare_amount, t.hold_status, t.held_at, t.expired_at, t.checkin_status,
bp.name AS passenger_name, bp.birth_date AS passenger_birth_date, bp.passenger_type,
s.seat_no, sc.class_name AS seat_class_name,
f.flight_no, TRIM(dep.iata_code) AS departure_iata_code, TRIM(arr.iata_code) AS arrival_iata_code, f.departure_time, f.arrival_time
FROM TICKET t JOIN BOOKING_PASSENGER bp ON bp.booking_passenger_id = t.booking_passenger_id JOIN SEAT s ON s.seat_id = t.seat_id JOIN SEAT_CLASS sc ON sc.seat_class_id = s.seat_class_id JOIN FLIGHT f ON f.flight_id = t.flight_id JOIN ROUTE r ON r.route_id = f.route_id JOIN AIRPORT dep ON dep.airport_id = r.departure_airport_id JOIN AIRPORT arr ON arr.airport_id = r.arrival_airport_id
WHERE t.booking_id = #{bookingId} ORDER BY CASE t.leg_type WHEN 'OUTBOUND' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, bp.booking_passenger_id

SELECT t.ticket_id, t.booking_id, t.booking_passenger_id, t.fare_amount, t.hold_status, t.leg_type FROM TICKET t WHERE t.booking_id = #{bookingId} AND t.hold_status = 'CONFIRMED'
AND t.booking_passenger_id = #{bookingPassengerId}
